{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'

sales_df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for the existence of 'order_type' column
print("Columns in the DataFrame:")
print(sales_df.columns)

# Check for the 'completed' status
print("Unique values in 'status' column:")
print(sales_df['status'].unique())"}
